evidence.reason: At the tip, DeployFixture.setUp still runs `git init`, sets the fixture user identity, stages files, and immediately commits without neutralizing inherited `commit.gpgSign`. A developer/CI global config with `commit.gpgSign=true` makes `git commit` attempt to sign with the fixture identity (`fixture@example.invalid`); with no matching key the commit fails and every DeployTests case errors in setUp. The remediation is a routine repository-local `git config commit.gpgSign false` before the first commit, so no owner decision is needed. None of the listed post-target commits changes the signing behavior of this fixture.
